title: Moon Landing - Vacation Rental in Watersound West,FL | 30a Escapes
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… "Moon Landing", your ultimate escape to paradise in Watersound West! Feel the ocean breeze as you cruise 30A in your 6-seater LSV or explore hidden gems on 6 beach bikes. Dive into relaxation at the zero-entry pool seconds away or take a peaceful stroll along the boardwalk to the serene, untouched beaches of Deer Lake State Park. Perfect for unforgettable family moments and pure coastal bliss. Learn more below… 👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Zero-Entry Community Pool – Dive into relaxation with a luxurious pool that’s perfect for everyone, offering smooth, easy access and a resort-style vibe.Boardwalk to Scenic Beach Access – Stroll along a picturesque boardwalk that leads straight to the pristine beach, where stunning views and serenity await.Chef’s Kitchen with High-End Appliances – Cook like a pro in a fully equipped kitchen featuring high-end stainless steel appliances.4 Bedrooms for Up to 8 Guests – Comfortably accommodate your group with 4 spacious bedrooms, perfect for up to 8 guests.6 Bikes for 30A Adventures – Embrace the breezy, laid-back 30A lifestyle as you pedal through charming coastal towns and scenic trails.6-Person LSV for Easy Exploration – Cruise around effortlessly in style with a comfortable Low Speed Vehicle, perfect for discovering all the local gems at your own pace.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "Amazing amenities and an effortless booking experience—our favorite house yet!" – Scott⭐ "Loved the serene boardwalk to the beach and bike rides around 30A. Truly unforgettable!" – Jessica⭐ "Perfect for our sisters' trip. The house was clean, spacious, and stunning!" – Paula*** LIVING AREA ***Unwind in spacious, open-concept living areas adorned with plush, inviting seating and a sleek flat-screen TV for your ultimate comfort. Step outside to the charming screened-in porch, complete with luxurious couches and a stylish dining table for six—a perfect setting for enjoying breezy, relaxed meals surrounded by nature.Spacious Open-Concept Living Area with Plenty of Comfortable SeatingCozy Screened-In Porch Featuring a Relaxing Lounge Area and a Dining Table for 6Versatile Second-Floor Living Space Perfect for Extra Hangouts or Relaxation*** KITCHEN & DINING ***Whip up culinary masterpieces in the fully equipped gourmet kitchen, complete with sleek stainless steel appliances and expansive counter space perfect for meal prep or entertaining. Gather around the elegant dining table that seats 8, or enjoy casual bites at the stylish kitchen island with seating for 4.Fully Equipped Kitchen with State-of-the-Art Modern Appliances, Including a Stainless Steel Refrigerator, Oven, and MicrowaveSpacious Dining Table Seating 8, Perfect for Family Gatherings or Dinner PartiesStylish Kitchen Island with Comfortable Seating for 4, Ideal for Casual Meals or Entertaining GuestsAmple Counter Space and Storage for all Your Cooking NeedsPremium Cookware, Utensils, and Dinnerware Provided for a Seamless Culinary Experience*** COMMUNITY AMENITIES ***Watersound West Beach offers unparalleled luxury with its exceptional amenities, including picturesque boardwalks that wind through breathtaking coastal scenery, immaculately landscaped parks perfect for relaxation, and exclusive, serene beach access through the untouched beauty of Deer Lake State Park. Experience the ultimate in coastal elegance and tranquility.Indulge in a Luxury Zero-Entry Community Pool, Perfect for Ultimate Relaxation and LeisureStroll Along Charming Boardwalks Surrounded by Picturesque Scenic ParksExperience Exclusive, Secluded Beach Access through the Stunning Deer Lake State Park*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:Luxurious Primary Suite: King Bed, Spa-Like Walk-In Shower, Dual Sinks for Added ConvenienceStylish Half Bathroom: Perfect for Guests2nd Floor:Elegant Primary Suite: King Bed, En-Suite Bathroom with Relaxing Soaking Tub, Walk-In Shower, and Dual Sinks2 Spacious Guest Suites: King Beds with Private En-Suites (1 with a Tub/Shower Combo, 1 with a Deluxe Walk-In Shower)*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Nestled in the serene Watersound West Community, experience the perfect blend of tranquility and access to 30A’s vibrant hotspots. Bike through scenic trails to Seagrove, wander the natural beauty of Deer Lake State Park, or take the convenient LSV to explore local dining, charming boutique shops, and everything this coastal paradise has to offer.10-Min Walk Scenic Boardwalk Stroll to the Beach – Take in the relaxing coastal breeze and stunning views as you walk to the sandy shores.3-5 Minutes Drive from Local Dining and Shops – Savor fresh, coastal flavors and browse charming boutiques just moments away.8-Min Drive to Seagrove Beach East – A quick trip to pristine, picture-perfect beaches for ultimate relaxation.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the LSV (Golf Cart) and 6 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***
